8.35.1. iLock_Geography.predicate_manager.PredicateManager¶

class iLock_Geography.predicate_manager.PredicateManager(railyard, useBuiltins=True)¶

A predicate manager is used to maintain a collection of registered names and the associated predicate instances.

Users who instantiate any predicate class, need to register the predicate instance with an unique name. The names and the associated predicates from iLock_Geography.builtins are automatically registered.

Special methods that are implemented:
  • __len__.
  • __getitem__.
  • __setitem__.
  • __delitem__.
  • __iter__.
  • __contains__.

Methods

__init__(railyard[, useBuiltins]) Constructor.
newName([nameTemplate]) An utility function that returns a name which does not clashes with the registered ones.
railyard() Return the associated railyard object.
typeManager() Return the TypeManager object which is created on the instantiation of PredicateManager.
